scripts.sync:dev: cp capacitor.config.dev.ts capacitor.config.ts && cp ios/App/App/GoogleService-Info.dev.plist ios/App/App/GoogleService-Info.plist && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sync:prod: cp capacitor.config.prod.ts capacitor.config.ts && cp ios/App/App/GoogleService-Info.prod.plist ios/App/App/GoogleService-Info.plist && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sync:dev-android: cp capacitor.config.dev.ts capacitor.config.ts && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:prod-android: cp capacitor.config.prod.ts capacitor.config.ts && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:stage-android: npm run sync:dev-android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleStageRelease
scripts.build:prod-android: npm run sync:prod-android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleProdRelease
